english.title: Contravene / fail to comply with condition of licence under the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) contravened or failed to comply with a condition attached to a licence issued under regulation 55 of the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017 in that, **(..SPECIFY THE CONDITION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 60(1) and (4) of the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 60(2) of the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017 provides that regulation 60(1) applies to a licence under regulation 55 granted on or after 21st August 2007.
(ii) Regulation 60(3) of the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017 provides that a person is not guilty of an offence under regulation 60 if he shows -
(a) he took all reasonable precautions and exercised all due diligence to avoid commission of the offence; or
(b) the commission of the offence was otherwise due to matters beyond his control.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant contravened or failed to comply with a condition attached to a licence issued under regulation 55 of the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017 in that, **(..SPECIFY THE CONDITION..).

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex: See regulation 129 for details.
